paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates how the metric labeled “minFDE\_20 (←)” varies with the number of in-context examples, comparing two selection methods. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Examples,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 0 to 8 with tick marks at each integer. The y-axis is labeled “minFDE\_20 (←),” uses a linear scale, and ranges from about 17 to 24 with major tick labels at 1-unit intervals. Two solid lines with circular markers are shown: the ST-ES series is a blue solid line with circle markers that starts around 21.6 at 0 examples, drops to about 18.2 at 1, then stays in the high-17s with values near 17.7 (2), 17.7 (3), 17.4 (4), 17.4 (5), reaching a low near 17.2 at 6, and ending around 17.4 at 8 (with about 17.45 at 7). The Random series is an orange solid line with circle markers that starts near 23.9 at 0 examples, declines to about 22.5 at 1 and 22.0 at 2, then remains around the low-21.7 to 21.8 range with approximately 21.8 (3), 21.8 (4), 21.7 (5), a slight uptick near 21.75 at 6 and 7, and ends near 21.6 at 8.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates how the metric minFDE\(_{20}\) (with a left-pointing arrow in the label) varies with the number of in-context examples for two selection methods (ST-ES and Random). The x-axis is labeled “Number of Examples,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 8 with labeled ticks at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8. The y-axis is labeled “minFDE\(_{20}\) (←),” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 17 to 24 with integer tick marks at regular intervals of 1. Two solid lines with circular markers are shown: the ST-ES series is a blue solid line with blue circle markers, starting near 21.6 at 0 examples, dropping to about 18.2 at 1 example, then moving around the high-17s through 8 examples (approximately 17.7 at 2, ~17.6 at 3, ~17.4 at 4–5, reaching a low near ~17.2 at 6, and ending around ~17.4 at 8). The Random series is an orange solid line with orange circle markers, starting near 23.9 at 0 examples, decreasing to about 22.5 at 1 and ~22.0 at 2, then staying around the low-21.7 range through 8 examples (about ~21.8 at 3–4, ~21.7 at 5, ~21.75 at 6–7, and ending near ~21.6 at 8).
